fullDiskAccess.title: Full Disk Access Required
fullDiskAccess.description: Cardinal needs macOS Full Disk Access to index and monitor files across your system. Please enable Full Disk Access for Cardinal in System Settings.

steps.one: Open System Settings > Privacy & Security > Full Disk Access.
steps.two: Click the lock to make changes and enable Cardinal.
steps.three: When prompted, allow macOS to restart Cardinal.

duplicates.explanation: Analyze the current file results by size and content. APFS clones, hard links, and physical copies are identified separately when macOS exposes reliable clone mapping.
duplicates.empty: No duplicate content was found in the current results.
duplicates.tooMany: Narrow the current results to 20,000 files or fewer before analyzing duplicates.
duplicates.tooLarge: The current results exceed the safe 50 GB duplicate-analysis limit. Narrow the results and try again.
duplicates.incomplete: {{count}} files were skipped because they were unavailable or the safe read limit was reached. Results may be incomplete.
duplicates.failed: Duplicate analysis could not be completed. Try narrowing the current results and run it again.

appCache.title: App cache
appCache.detail: Apps rebuild it when needed. Quit the app before removing it.

xcodeDeviceSupport.title: Xcode device support
xcodeDeviceSupport.detail: Symbols for connected devices; downloaded again when needed.

xcodeArchives.title: Xcode archives
xcodeArchives.detail: Archives of shipped builds; keep them if you need their dSYMs.

simulatorDevices.title: iOS simulator devices
simulatorDevices.detail: Prefer Xcode › Devices or `xcrun simctl delete unavailable`.

androidEmulators.title: Android emulators
androidEmulators.detail: Remove unused virtual devices in Android Studio › Device Manager.

androidSystemImages.title: Android system images
androidSystemImages.detail: Emulator images; uninstall unused ones in the SDK Manager.

packageCache.title: Package cache
packageCache.detail: Dependencies are downloaded again on the next build.

toolCache.title: Tool cache (~/.cache)
toolCache.detail: Caches of various tools; most are regenerated, take a look first.

spotifyCache.title: Spotify offline cache
spotifyCache.detail: You can also limit the cache size in Spotify's settings.

deviceBackups.title: iPhone/iPad backups
deviceBackups.detail: Old device backups; delete them in Finder › device › Manage Backups.

docker.title: Docker disk image
docker.detail: Shrink it with Docker Desktop or `docker system prune`.

trash.title: Trash
trash.detail: Already in the Trash; space is freed when you empty it (cannot be undone).

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.detail: Forgotten large files tend to pile up here; take a look.

installer.title: Installer file
installer.detail: Not needed once the app is installed.

oldExtensions.title: Old editor extension versions
oldExtensions.detail: Superseded versions of VS Code / Cursor / Antigravity extensions; the editor uses the newest one.

chromeServiceWorker.title: Chrome Service Worker cache
chromeServiceWorker.detail: Websites' offline caches; they are rebuilt, but sites lose offline data until revisited.

pnpmStore.title: pnpm package store
pnpmStore.detail: Shared package store; projects re-download packages on the next install. `pnpm store prune` removes only unused ones.

googleUpdaterCache.title: Google Updater cache
googleUpdaterCache.detail: Downloaded update packages of Google apps; fetched again when needed.

editorCache.title: Editor cache
editorCache.detail: VS Code / Cursor / Antigravity caches; rebuilt when the editor starts. Quit the editor first.

clangModuleCache.title: Clang module cache
clangModuleCache.detail: Compiled module cache of Xcode/clang; rebuilt on the next build.

editorWebCache.title: Editor webview cache
editorWebCache.detail: Cached web content of editor panels and extensions (VS Code, Cursor, Antigravity); rebuilt when needed. Quit the editor first.

vsixCache.title: Editor extension download cache
vsixCache.detail: Downloaded .vsix packages kept after installing extensions; downloaded again when needed.

codexRuntimeInstall.title: Codex runtime install leftovers
codexRuntimeInstall.detail: Unfinished Codex runtime installs; the runtimes Codex actually uses are not listed.
